title: Stray PvP
description: 🗡️ Stray PvP is a Minecraft server with free-for-all PvP, Sandbox, UHC and events. Supports Minecraft 1.20–1.21.x.
body: ![Stray Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6442e178056f0f68a23e00058c0909dda50653b5.png) ![Line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b559fae3ddabe7f1b8b04b980ec8946a0b5069cd.png) # ⚔️ Stray PvP ⚔️ Stray PvP is a competitive Minecraft server where you can fight other players in a free-for-all arena. Improve your skills and compete with players worldwide. Stray PvP supports multiple regions, including **Europe**, **North America** and **Asia**. You can join using Minecraft version **1.20 – 1.21.x.** 📍 **IP**: stray.gg (NA), eu.stray.gg (EU), as.stray.gg (AS) 🌀 Discord: [https://discord.gg/stray](https://discord.gg/stray) 🛒 Store: [store.stray.gg](https://store.stray.gg/) 📕 Code of Conduct: [conduct.stray.gg](https://conduct.stray.gg/) ![Line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b559fae3ddabe7f1b8b04b980ec8946a0b5069cd.png) # 🎙️Voice Chat Support Stray PvP now supports the Simple Voice Chat mod! Talk with nearby players in-game using Forge or Fabric. Voice Chat follows our Code of Conduct; breaking rules may result in in-game muting. # 🏆 New Competitive Gamemode: UHC ⚔️ Stray PvP now features UHC Season 0 with a $3,000 prize pool! This beta season runs until **June 2026**. Compete for prizes including: 🏆 #1 ELO: 💵 $1,000 🏆 #2 ELO: 💵 $500 🏆 #3 ELO: 💵 $250 🏆 #1 Wins: 💵 $500 # 🏖️ Sandbox Try our Sandbox mode for free-play PvP practice! We’ve developed our own Crystal Optimizer to make crystal placements faster and more efficient. You can create custom kits and fight in a **box arena** and explore multiple RTP maps, including Badlands, Plains, Desert, Mushroom, **Snowy Plains**, and Flat. ![Line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b559fae3ddabe7f1b8b04b980ec8946a0b5069cd.png)
